planets.name: K2-366 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-366 with a 15.9-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: K2-366 b was found in 2022 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-366. Its orbit and size follow Christiansen et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
